visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Text of Exactly the Limit Is Cut
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A text that is exactly 10 characters long fits in a limit of 10 and should stay unchanged, but it is truncated.

solution.explanation: A text of exactly max characters still fits, so the check must allow equality (<=). With < the boundary case is shortened even though no shortening is needed.
